_doc: What the human-view bot can see (Batch 2, BACKLOG-R4). The camera box mirrors packages/render-3d/src/units.ts (the bots never import render code; packages/bots/test/view.test.ts checks these against it). The ground width comes from @fo/content data/look.json (viewW by level family times groundK, the mean of the wider ground toward the top edge). aspect is the play area's height over width on a portrait phone (390x844 less the HUD rows). heroShift is the share of the screen height the look point sits above the hero (renderer followCamera).
